# Meddleware developer documentation

> How to build on Meddleware's Sui and Walrus tooling: TypeScript SDKs, Move packages, PTB patterns, the access-gate gateway protocol and running your own relay or gateway. All repositories are public under 0BSD.

The full text of this site in one file: [llms-full.txt](https://dev.meddleware.co.uk/llms-full.txt). User documentation: [docs.meddleware.co.uk/llms.txt](https://docs.meddleware.co.uk/llms.txt).

## Getting started

- [Overview](https://dev.meddleware.co.uk/)
- [Getting started](https://dev.meddleware.co.uk/getting-started/), [toolchain](https://dev.meddleware.co.uk/getting-started/toolchain), [local development](https://dev.meddleware.co.uk/getting-started/local-dev)
- [Sui environment](https://dev.meddleware.co.uk/sui/environment), [PTB patterns](https://dev.meddleware.co.uk/sui/ptb-patterns)

## Products

- [Walrus Storage](https://dev.meddleware.co.uk/sui/walrus-storage/): [integration](https://dev.meddleware.co.uk/sui/walrus-storage/integration), [run your own upload relay](https://dev.meddleware.co.uk/sui/walrus-storage/relay-self-host); SDK `@meddleware/walrus-storage-client`
- [Sealed Storage](https://dev.meddleware.co.uk/sui/sealed-storage/): [integration](https://dev.meddleware.co.uk/sui/sealed-storage/integration), [policies](https://dev.meddleware.co.uk/sui/sealed-storage/policies); SDK `@meddleware/sealed-storage-client`
- [Access Gate](https://dev.meddleware.co.uk/sui/access-gate/): [integration](https://dev.meddleware.co.uk/sui/access-gate/integration), [gateway and wire protocol](https://dev.meddleware.co.uk/sui/access-gate/gateway); SDKs `@meddleware/access-gate-client`, `@meddleware/access-gate-gateway-client`
- Token Issuance: [overview](https://dev.meddleware.co.uk/sui/onchain/token-issuance/overview), [developer guide](https://dev.meddleware.co.uk/sui/onchain/token-issuance/dev-guide), [API reference](https://dev.meddleware.co.uk/sui/onchain/token-issuance/api-reference); SDK `@meddleware/token-issuance-client`

## Move packages (API references)

- [access_gate](https://dev.meddleware.co.uk/sui/onchain/access-gate/api-reference) ([developer guide](https://dev.meddleware.co.uk/sui/onchain/access-gate/dev-guide))
- [sealed_storage](https://dev.meddleware.co.uk/sui/onchain/sealed-storage/api-reference) ([developer guide](https://dev.meddleware.co.uk/sui/onchain/sealed-storage/dev-guide))
